nights.title: Fetty Wap: Nostalgia Tour
nights.name: Fetty Wap
nights.extract: Willie Junior Maxwell II, better known by his stage name Fetty Wap, is an American rapper, singer, and songwriter. He quickly rose to mainstream prominence after his 2014 song "Trap Queen" peaked at number two on the Billboard Hot 100 and led him to sign with 300 Entertainment, an imprint of Atlantic Records. Two of his 2015 singles, "679" and "My Way", peaked within the top ten of the chart; all three—as well as the top 40 single "Again"—preceded his eponymous debut studio album (2015), which peaked atop the Billboard 200. During this time, he became distinctive for his melodic blending of singing and rapping, lighthearted lyrics, "bouncy" production, and exclamation of various catchphrases

nights.title: Mountain Grass Unit
nights.name: Mountain Grass Unit
nights.extract: Mountain Grass Unit (MGU) is a four-piece bluegrass band founded in Birmingham, Alabama in 2018. The band consists of members Drury Anderson (lead vocals, mandolin), Luke Black (guitar), Sam Wilson (bass), and Josiah Nelson (fiddle). Unlike typical bluegrass arrangements, MGU does not feature a banjo.
